{{Quote|This is a Class-A thermal detonator, you know what that means?|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] '''Class-A thermal detonator''' was a grenade widely used by armed forces, illegal militias, and rebel groups across the galaxy, though highly illegal for anyone other than military personnel to possess.

==Description==
A Class-A [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] was a small metal sphere surrounding a core that consisted of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] covered in a layer of [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It had blast radius of twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]], making it the most powerful commercially manufactured detonator in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;however, some custom-made thermal detonators were even more powerful. The weapons cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="FF" />

==History==
[[File:Boushh_ep_6.png|thumb|left|300px|Leia Organa holds a Class-A thermal detonator to threaten Jabba the Hutt]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers tuned down the grenade's blast radius for battlefield purposes while maintaining its effectiveness.<ref name="BF guide" />

A single Class-A thermal detonator was sufficient to cause the collapse of [[Xizor's Palace]], a huge 102-story building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] dropped it down the palace's garbage chute into its basement level.<ref name="SOTE" /> Another Class-A detonator was used by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], in her guise as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], to threaten [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in her attempt to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]-turned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] used thermal detonators in his missions for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="JK:JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Jedi [[Myrkr strike team]] used Class-A detonators in their seek-and-destroy mission.<ref name="Star by Star" />

==Behind the scenes==
Class-A thermal detonators first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. In the ''[[Battlefront]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series, they serve as the primary grenades for Rebel soldiers.
